about: Image.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(radius)): three passes of an extended box blur (BoxBlur.c). The renderer blurs its L shadow masks by 0.7 and the RGB bloom source (90 x 160) by 3.0
note: args: mode, size (width, height), radius as passed (a float.hex() string; Pillow reads it as a C float). Arrays "in" and "out" are (height, width) for L, (height, width, 3) for RGB.
